answer: The comet multiplier is published, charged in lantern, and river lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1963 identities would post 4964 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
